TravelClient.source:
-- TravelClient (2026-10-05, Claude): the snowy TRAVEL menu + the compact TRAVEL button next to HELP + the lobby pad prompt.
-- Lists Lobby, My Garage and every stage of StageConfig (TravelConfig), split by world, marks the current spot and shows the real
-- unlock requirement of locked stages. Sends only a destination id to the server (TravelRemote); the server validates and moves you.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local PPS = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local T = require(RS:WaitForChild("TravelConfig"))
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("TravelRemote", 30)
if not remote then return end
local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local FONT, NAVY, WHITE = Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 85), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local touch = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function stroke(o, t, c) return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = t or 2.5, Color = c or NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = o:IsA("TextLabel") and Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual or Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o) end
local function label(parent, text, props)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, Text = text, TextColor3 = WHITE}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	stroke(l, 2, NAVY)
	return l
end

------------------------------------------------ HUD button (beside HELP)
local hud = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "TravelGui", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 12}, pg)
local btn = mk("TextButton", {Name = "TravelButton", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 175, 255),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 42), Position = UDim2.new(0.11, 0, 0.84, 0), Visible = false, Selectable = true}, hud)
btn:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)}, btn)
stroke(btn, 3)
mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255), Color3.fromRGB(170, 205, 245))}, btn)
label(btn, "\u{1F9ED} TRAVEL", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.72), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.14)})
local helpBtn
local function placeButton()
	if helpBtn and helpBtn.Parent and helpBtn.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
		-- use the same top-bar inset rules as HELP's ScreenGui, so both share one coordinate space
		local sg = helpBtn:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if sg then
			hud.IgnoreGuiInset = sg.IgnoreGuiInset
			pcall(function() hud.ScreenInsets = sg.ScreenInsets end)
		end
		local ap, as = helpBtn.AbsolutePosition, helpBtn.AbsoluteSize
		btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(as.X * 0.95), math.floor(as.Y))
		-- AbsolutePosition is measured below the top bar even in an IgnoreGuiInset gui, so add the inset back for Position
		local top = hud.IgnoreGuiInset and GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y or 0
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(ap.X + as.X + 12), math.floor(ap.Y + top))
	end
end
task.spawn(function() -- the HELP button is made at runtime by the tutorial; follow it so TRAVEL never overlaps it on any screen size
	for _ = 1, 120 do
		for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
			if (d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) and d ~= btn and d.Visible then
				local txt = d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Text or ""
				local child = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
				-- the bottom-left HUD HELP button (not the tutorial card's small "? HELP" at the top)
				local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
				local bottomLeft = d.AbsolutePosition.Y > vp.Y * 0.55 and d.AbsolutePosition.X < vp.X * 0.3
				if bottomLeft and (txt:upper():find("HELP") or (child and child.Text:upper():find("HELP"))) and d.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then helpBtn = d break end
			end
		end
		if helpBtn then break end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	if helpBtn then
		helpBtn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(placeButton)
		helpBtn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(placeButton)
		placeButton()
	end
end)
local function hudVisible()
	return player:GetAttribute("PlowTutorialDone") == true and player:GetAttribute("InArenaIsland") ~= true and player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") ~= true
end
local function refreshHud() btn.Visible = hudVisible() end
for _, a in ipairs({"PlowTutorialDone", "InArenaIsland", "IntroActive"}) do player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(a):Connect(refreshHud) end
refreshHud()

------------------------------------------------ the menu (built from the Settings panel so it matches the snowy panels)
local panel, content, toast, rows = nil, nil, nil, {}
local current, pendingConfirm = nil, nil
local refresh -- defined below (rows call it after a travel attempt)
local function buildPanel()
	if panel then return panel end
	local rng = pg:WaitForChild("RNGGui", 20)
	local panels = rng and rng:WaitForChild("Panels", 10)
	local proto = panels and panels:WaitForChild("Settings", 10)
	if proto then
		panel = proto:Clone()
		panel.Name = "Travel"; panel.Visible = false
		local title = panel:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		if title then title.Text = "\u{1F9ED} TRAVEL" end
		local icon = panel:FindFirstChild("Banner") and panel.Banner:FindFirstChild("Icon")
		if icon then icon.Visible = false end
		content = panel:FindFirstChild("Content", true)
		for _, c in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
		local close = panel:FindFirstChild("Close")
		if close then close.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end) end
		panel.Parent = panels
	else -- fallback (no Settings panel): plain frame
		local sg = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "TravelMenu", ResetOnSpawn = false}, pg)
		panel = mk("Frame", {Name = "Travel", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 210), Visible = false}, sg)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.04, 0)}, panel)
		content = mk("ScrollingFrame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.86), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.1), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, panel)
		mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, content)
		local x = mk("TextButton", {Text = "X", Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.08), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.91, 0.01), Font = FONT, TextScaled = true}, panel)
		x.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)
	end
	content.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	content.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	toast = label(panel, "", {Name = "TravelToast", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.9), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.05), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 150), ZIndex = 5})
	local order = 0
	local lastWorld
	for _, dest in ipairs(T.List) do
		if dest.World ~= lastWorld then
			lastWorld = dest.World
			order += 1
			local head = mk("Frame", {Name = "World" .. dest.World, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), LayoutOrder = order}, content)
			label(head, T.WorldNames[dest.World] or ("WORLD " .. dest.World), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.8), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 230, 255)})
		end
		order += 1
		local row = mk("Frame", {Name = dest.Id, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, touch and 78 or 68), LayoutOrder = order, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 66, 128)}, content)
		row:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.22, 0)}, row)
		stroke(row, 2.5)
		local name = label(row, (T.Icons[dest.Id] or "") .. "  " .. dest.Name, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.08), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
		local info = label(row, "", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.32), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.6), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 225, 250)})
		local go = mk("TextButton", {Name = "Go", Text = "", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.97, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.74),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 105), AutoButtonColor = true, Selectable = true}, row)
		go:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0)}, go)
		stroke(go, 3)
		local goText = label(go, "GO", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.7), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.15)})
		rows[dest.Id] = {row = row, name = name, info = info, go = go, goText = goText, dest = dest}
		go.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not T.Unlocked(player, dest) or current == dest.Id then return end
			local confirm = pendingConfirm and pendingConfirm.id == dest.Id and os.clock() < pendingConfirm.untilT
			goText.Text = "..."
			local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("Travel", dest.Id, confirm) end)
			if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.needConfirm then
				pendingConfirm = {id = dest.Id, untilT = os.clock() + 8}
				toast.Text = res.msg
				goText.Text = "SURE?"
				return
			end
			pendingConfirm = nil
			if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.ok then
				current = res.at or dest.Id
				toast.Text = res.msg or ""
				panel.Visible = false
			else
				toast.Text = (ok and type(res) == "table" and res.msg) or "Travel failed - try again."
			end
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	return panel
end

function refresh()
	if not panel then return end
	for id, r in pairs(rows) do
		local open = T.Unlocked(player, r.dest)
		local here = current == id
		r.row.BackgroundColor3 = here and Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 80) or (open and Color3.fromRGB(34, 66, 128) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 78, 98))
		r.info.Text = here and "YOU ARE HERE" or (open and (id == "Garage" and "Roll, buy and equip parts" or "Free travel") or ("\u{1F512} " .. T.Requirement(r.dest)))
		r.go.Visible = open and not here
		r.go.Selectable = r.go.Visible
		if not (pendingConfirm and pendingConfirm.id == id) then r.goText.Text = "GO" end
	end
end

local function open()
	if not hudVisible() and player:GetAttribute("PlowTutorialDone") ~= true then return end
	buildPanel()
	if player:GetAttribute("InArenaIsland") then return end
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("Where") end)
	current = ok and type(res) == "table" and res.at or nil
	pendingConfirm = nil
	toast.Text = ""
	refresh()
	if panel.Parent and panel.Parent.Name == "Panels" then for _, p in ipairs(panel.Parent:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("GuiObject") and p ~= panel then p.Visible = false end end end
	panel.Visible = true
	if UIS.GamepadEnabled and UIS:GetLastInputType().Name:find("^Gamepad") then
		for _, dest in ipairs(T.List) do local r = rows[dest.Id]; if r and r.go.Visible then GuiService.SelectedObject = r.go break end end
	end
end
btn.Activated:Connect(function() if panel and panel.Visible then panel.Visible = false else open() end end)
PPS.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt) if prompt.Name == "TravelPadPrompt" then open() end end)
-- locks refresh at once after a stage purchase or a rebirth
for _, dest in ipairs(T.List) do
	if dest.Kind == "Stage" then player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stage_" .. dest.Stage):Connect(function() if panel and panel.Visible then refresh() end end) end
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InGarage"):Connect(function() if panel and panel.Visible then current = player:GetAttribute("InGarage") and "Garage" or current; refresh() end end)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InArenaIsland"):Connect(function() if player:GetAttribute("InArenaIsland") and panel then panel.Visible = false end end)

ContractClient.source:
-- ContractClient (2026-10-05, Claude): draws the NPC clearing contracts ("Help Yards"); ContractService (server) decides everything.
-- HELP REQUEST announcement (HELP OUT / LATER), a small available-job pill, the objective tracker (sub-objectives, progress, time, reward,
-- cancel), a waypoint to the NPC, outlines + labels on the marked work areas (owner only), and the scene reactions every player sees
-- (lamps, shutters, crates rising, bus / van arriving, pump spinning) driven by the scene's public attributes.
-- Suppressed (popup + pill hidden) while LocalPlayer attribute SuppressEvents == true (the tutorial sets it during essential steps),
-- during the intro / first tutorial, in the garage and during the Frost King announcement/fight. Mute keeps the pill, hides the popup.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local CFG = require(RS:WaitForChild("ContractConfig"))
local Format = require(RS:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local okUI, UI = pcall(function() return require(RS:WaitForChild("SnowUI", 10)) end)
local event = RS:WaitForChild("ContractEvent")
local request = RS:WaitForChild("ContractRequest")
local function now() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local WHITE, NAVY = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 85)
local ICE, GREEN, GREY, GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(150, 225, 255), Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 110), Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 185), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110)
local PEND = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 70)
local touch = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled
local function fmtTime(s) s = math.max(0, math.floor(s + 0.5)); return ("%d:%02d"):format(s // 60, s % 60) end

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function label(parent, text, props)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, Text = text, TextColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 6}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.2, Color = NAVY}, l)
	return l
end
local function panel(parent, props)
	local f = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 232, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do f[k] = v end
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.12, 0)}, f)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, f)
	if okUI then pcall(UI.Skin, f, "card") end
	return f
end
local function button(parent, text, color, props)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {AutoButtonColor = true, BackgroundColor3 = color, Text = "", ZIndex = 7, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do b[k] = v end
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0)}, b)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	local l = label(b, text, {Name = "Text", Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.7), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.15), ZIndex = 8})
	b:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	return b, l
end
local function portraitOf(img, userId, icon)
	img.Image = ""
	local ic = img:FindFirstChild("Icon")
	if ic then ic.Text = icon or "\u{2744}"; ic.Visible = true end
	if userId and userId > 0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, url = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150) end)
			if ok and url then img.Image = url; if ic then ic.Visible = false end end
		end)
	end
end
local function portrait(parent, props)
	local f = mk("ImageLabel", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 240), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 7, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do f[k] = v end
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)}, f)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = NAVY}, f)
	mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, f)
	label(f, "\u{2744}", {Name = "Icon", Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1), ZIndex = 8})
	return f
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- GUI
--------------------------------------------------
local gui = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "ContractGui", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = false, DisplayOrder = 55, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
-- announcement
local ann = panel(gui, {Name = "Announce", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.9 or 0.44, touch and 0.36 or 0.3)})
mk("UISizeConstraint", {MaxSize = Vector2.new(620, 300)}, ann)
local annScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, ann)
local annTitle = label(ann, "HELP REQUEST!", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.04), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.2), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, ICE)}, annTitle)
local annPortrait = portrait(ann, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.08), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.5)})
local annWho = label(ann, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.25), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.14), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
local annJob = label(ann, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.4), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.13), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = GOLD})
local annInfo = label(ann, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.56), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.11), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 240, 255)})
local annReward = label(ann, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.66), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.1), TextColor3 = GOLD})
local helpBtn, helpText = button(ann, "HELP OUT", GREEN, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.79), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.44, 0.17)})
local laterBtn = button(ann, "LATER", GREY, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.79), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.17)})
-- available-job pill
local pill = panel(gui, {Name = "Pill", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.012, touch and 0.62 or 0.76), Size = UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.42 or 0.2, touch and 0.075 or 0.062)})
local pillBtn = mk("TextButton", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.78, 1), ZIndex = 9}, pill)
local pillText = label(pill, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.72), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
local muteBtn, muteText = button(pill, "\u{1F514}", Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.17, 0.72)})
-- tracker
local tracker = panel(gui, {Name = "Tracker", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.8 or 0.925, touch and 0.16 or 0.27), Size = UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.42 or 0.21, touch and 0.36 or 0.33)})
mk("UISizeConstraint", {MaxSize = Vector2.new(360, 340)}, tracker)
local trPortrait = portrait(tracker, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.16, 0.16)})
local trName = label(tracker, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.23, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, 0.09), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
local trWho = label(tracker, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.23, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, 0.07), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = ICE})
local rowsFrame = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.22), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.46), ZIndex = 6}, tracker)
mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0.02, 0), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, rowsFrame)
local barBack = mk("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.7), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.07), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 40, 80), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6}, tracker)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)}, barBack)
local barFill = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = GREEN, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 7}, barBack)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)}, barFill)
local barText = label(barBack, "", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 8})
local trTime = label(tracker, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.79), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.08), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
local trReward = label(tracker, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.47, 0.79), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.48, 0.08), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextColor3 = GOLD})
local cancelBtn, cancelText = button(tracker, "CANCEL", Color3.fromRGB(235, 95, 105), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.89), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.09)})
-- toast
local toast = panel(gui, {Name = "Toast", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), Size = UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.86 or 0.4, 0.09)})
local toastText = label(toast, "", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.76)})
local toastToken = 0
local function showToast(text, color, secs)
	toastToken += 1
	local my = toastToken
	toastText.Text = text; toastText.TextColor3 = color or WHITE
	toast.Visible = true
	task.delay(secs or 3.5, function() if toastToken == my then toast.Visible = false end end)
end
local function sound(id, vol)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound"); s.SoundId = id; s.Volume = vol or 0.4; s.Parent = gui; s:Play()
	s.Ended:Connect(function() s:Destroy() end)
	task.delay(6, function() if s.Parent then s:Destroy() end end)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- state
--------------------------------------------------
local offer, job = nil, nil
local popupOpen, dismissed = false, {}
local muted = false
local cancelArmed = 0
local function suppressed()
	if player:GetAttribute("SuppressEvents") == true or player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") == true then return true end
	if player:GetAttribute("PlowTutorialDone") ~= true or player:GetAttribute("InGarage") == true then return true end
	local fk = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("FrostKingGui")
	if fk and ((fk:FindFirstChild("Announce") and fk.Announce.Visible) or (fk:FindFirstChild("BossBar") and fk.BossBar.Visible)) then return true end
	return false
end
local function call(action, id, value)
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return request:InvokeServer(action, id, value) end)
	if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return {ok = false, msg = "Connection problem - try again."} end
	return res
end

-- world guidance (owner only)
local fx = mk("Folder", {Name = "ContractClientFX"}, workspace)
local outline = {} -- [group] = {parts, label}
local wp = {}
local function clearGuidance()
	fx:ClearAllChildren()
	outline, wp = {}, {}
end
local function edge(parent, a, b, color)
	local mid, len = (a + b) / 2, (b - a).Magnitude
	return mk("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = color,
		Transparency = 0.15, Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.25, len + 0.35), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, b)}, parent)
end
local function buildGuidance(j)
	clearGuidance()
	for _, z in ipairs(j.Zones or {}) do
		local c, hw, hd = z.Center + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), z.W / 2, z.D / 2
		local p = {c + Vector3.new(-hw, 0, -hd), c + Vector3.new(hw, 0, -hd), c + Vector3.new(hw, 0, hd), c + Vector3.new(-hw, 0, hd)}
		local o = outline[z.Group] or {parts = {}}
		outline[z.Group] = o
		for k = 1, 4 do table.insert(o.parts, edge(fx, p[k], p[k % 4 + 1], PEND)) end
		if not o.label then
			local anchor = mk("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))}, fx)
			local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 44), AlwaysOnTop = false, LightInfluence = 0, MaxDistance = 140, Adornee = anchor}, anchor)
			o.label = label(bb, "", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
		end
	end
	-- waypoint: a marker over the NPC and a soft beam from you to it
	local tp = mk("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(j.Waypoint + Vector3.new(0, 11, 0))}, fx)
	local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 60), AlwaysOnTop = false, LightInfluence = 0, MaxDistance = 2000, Adornee = tp}, tp)
	wp.text = label(bb, "", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextColor3 = GOLD})
	wp.part = tp
	wp.a1 = mk("Attachment", {}, tp)
end
local function refreshLabels(j)
	for _, g in ipairs(j.Groups or {}) do
		local o = outline[g.Key]
		if o then
			local need = math.max(1, math.ceil(g.Total * CFG.Job.Tolerance))
			local pct = math.clamp(math.floor(g.Cleared / need * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100)
			o.label.Text = g.Done and ("\u{2714} " .. g.Label) or (g.Label .. "  " .. pct .. "%")
			o.label.TextColor3 = g.Done and GREEN or WHITE
			for _, p in ipairs(o.parts) do p.Color = g.Done and GREEN or PEND end
		end
	end
end

-- tracker
local rowLabels = {}
local function buildTracker(j)
	for _, r in ipairs(rowLabels) do r:Destroy() end
	rowLabels = {}
	for i, g in ipairs(j.Groups) do
		local r = label(rowsFrame, "", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, math.min(0.18, 0.9 / #j.Groups)), LayoutOrder = i, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})
		rowLabels[i] = r
	end
	trName.Text = (j.Icon or "") .. " " .. j.Name
	trWho.Text = j.NpcName .. (j.IsFriend and "  (NPC helper)" or "")
	trReward.Text = "\u{2744} +" .. Format.Abbreviate(j.Reward) .. " bonus"
	portraitOf(trPortrait, j.NpcUserId, j.Icon)
end
local function refreshTracker(j)
	local need, have = 0, 0
	for i, g in ipairs(j.Groups) do
		local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(g.Total * CFG.Job.Tolerance))
		need += n; have += math.min(n, g.Cleared)
		local r = rowLabels[i]
		if r then
			r.Text = (g.Done and "\u{2714} " or "\u{25CB} ") .. g.Label .. (g.Done and "" or ("  " .. math.floor(math.min(1, g.Cleared / n) * 100) .. "%"))
			r.TextColor3 = g.Done and GREEN or WHITE
		end
	end
	local f = need > 0 and have / need or 0
	barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(f, 0, 1), 1)
	barText.Text = math.floor(f * 100) .. "%"
	refreshLabels(j)
end

local function showOffer(o, force)
	offer = o
	dismissed[o.Id] = dismissed[o.Id] or false
	annWho.Text = o.NpcName .. " needs help!"
	annJob.Text = (o.Icon or "") .. " " .. o.Name
	annInfo.Text = "Estimated time: 1\u{2013}3 minutes  \u{2022}  " .. o.StageName
	annReward.Text = "Reward: \u{2744} +" .. Format.Abbreviate(o.Reward) .. " bonus + the Snow you clear"
	portraitOf(annPortrait, o.NpcUserId, o.Icon)
	if (force or (not muted and not dismissed[o.Id])) and not suppressed() and not job then
		popupOpen = true
		ann.Visible = true
		annScale.Scale = 0.85
		TweenService:Create(annScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play()
		if not force then sound("rbxassetid://12221976", 0.3) end
		local id = o.Id
		task.delay(25, function() if offer and offer.Id == id and popupOpen then popupOpen = false; ann.Visible = false; dismissed[id] = true end end)
	end
end
local function startJob(j)
	job, offer = j, nil
	ann.Visible, popupOpen = false, false
	buildTracker(j)
	buildGuidance(j)
	refreshTracker(j)
	tracker.Visible = true
end
local function endJob()
	job = nil
	tracker.Visible = false
	clearGuidance()
end

-- scene reactions (everyone sees them; driven by the scene's public attributes)
--------------------------------------------------
local scenes = {}
local function vec(s) local x, y, z = tostring(s or ""):match("([-%d%.]+),([-%d%.]+),([-%d%.]+)"); return Vector3.new(tonumber(x) or 0, tonumber(y) or 0, tonumber(z) or 0) end
local function setLamps(m, on)
	for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("LampPart") then
			local c = d:GetAttribute("OnColor")
			if on then d.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; if c then d.Color = c end end
			local pl = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight"); if pl then pl.Enabled = on end
		end
	end
end
local function setHidden(m, hidden)
	for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hidden and 1 or 0 end end
end
local function tweenPivot(m, from, to, secs, fade)
	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while m.Parent do
			local k = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / secs, 0, 1)
			local e = 1 - (1 - k) ^ 3
			m:PivotTo(from:Lerp(to, e))
			if fade then for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.max(0, 1 - k * 3) end end end
			if k >= 1 then break end
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
	end)
end
local function setupScene(sc)
	if scenes[sc] then return end
	local e = {items = {}, done = {}, completed = false}
	scenes[sc] = e
	local origin = sc:FindFirstChild("Origin")
	local props = sc:WaitForChild("Props", 10)
	if not props then return end
	for _, m in ipairs(props:GetChildren()) do
		local it = {m = m, base = m:GetPivot()}
		table.insert(e.items, it)
		if m:GetAttribute("ArriveOnComplete") or m:GetAttribute("ShowOnGroup") then setHidden(m, true) end
		if m:GetAttribute("RiseWithGroup") then m:PivotTo(it.base + Vector3.new(0, m:GetAttribute("RiseFrom") or -3, 0)) end
	end
	local paint = sc:FindFirstChild("Surfaces")
	local function apply()
		for _, it in ipairs(e.items) do
			local m = it.m
			local g = m:GetAttribute("LightOnGroup")
			if g and sc:GetAttribute("Done_" .. g) and not it.lit then it.lit = true; setLamps(m, true) end
			if m:GetAttribute("LightOnComplete") and sc:GetAttribute("Completed") and not it.lit then it.lit = true; setLamps(m, true) end
			local sg = m:GetAttribute("SlideOnGroup")
			if sg and sc:GetAttribute("Done_" .. sg) and not it.slid then it.slid = true; tweenPivot(m, it.base, it.base + Vector3.new(0, m:GetAttribute("SlideY") or 3, 0), 1.2) end
			local show = m:GetAttribute("ShowOnGroup")
			if show and sc:GetAttribute("Done_" .. show) and not it.shown then it.shown = true; setHidden(m, false) end
			local rg = m:GetAttribute("RiseWithGroup")
			if rg then
				local f = sc:GetAttribute("G_" .. rg) or 0
				local target = it.base + Vector3.new(0, (m:GetAttribute("RiseFrom") or -3) * (1 - f), 0)
				if (m:GetPivot().Position - target.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then tweenPivot(m, m:GetPivot(), target, 0.5) end
			end
			local rot = m:GetAttribute("RotateOnGroup")
			if rot and sc:GetAttribute("Done_" .. rot) and not it.rotated then
				it.rotated = true
				local ax = m:GetAttribute("RotateAxis") == "X" and Vector3.xAxis or (m:GetAttribute("RotateAxis") == "Y" and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.zAxis)
				tweenPivot(m, it.base, it.base * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ax, math.rad(m:GetAttribute("RotateDeg") or 80)), 1.0)
			end
			if sc:GetAttribute("Completed") then
				if m:GetAttribute("RemoveOnComplete") and not it.removed then it.removed = true; tweenPivot(m, it.base, it.base - Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), 1.5) end
				if m:GetAttribute("ArriveOnComplete") and not it.arrived then
					it.arrived = true
					local from = (origin and origin.CFrame or CFrame.new()):VectorToWorldSpace(vec(m:GetAttribute("ArriveFrom")))
					tweenPivot(m, it.base + from, it.base, 3.2, true)
				end
				if m:GetAttribute("SpinOnComplete") and not it.spinning then it.spinning = true end
				if m:GetAttribute("WaterOnComplete") and not it.water then
					it.water = true
					local spout = m:FindFirstChild("Spout") or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
					if spout then
						local att = mk("Attachment", {}, spout)
						mk("ParticleEmitter", {Rate = 40, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.9), Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(12, 12),
							Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)), LightEmission = 0.4,
							Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0.1), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 0.8)}, att)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if paint then
			for _, p in ipairs(paint:GetChildren()) do
				local g = p:GetAttribute("GlowOnGroup")
				if g and sc:GetAttribute("Done_" .. g) and p.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; p.Color = p:GetAttribute("OnColor") or p.Color end
			end
		end
	end
	sc.AttributeChanged:Connect(apply)
	apply()
end
local function watchYard(y)
	local s = y:WaitForChild("Scene", 20)
	if not s then return end
	s.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name:sub(1, 6) == "Scene_" then task.spawn(setupScene, c) end end)
	s.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c) scenes[c] = nil end)
	for _, c in ipairs(s:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name:sub(1, 6) == "Scene_" then task.spawn(setupScene, c) end end
end
task.spawn(function()
	local yf = workspace:WaitForChild("ContractYards", 60)
	if not yf then return end
	yf.ChildAdded:Connect(watchYard)
	for _, y in ipairs(yf:GetChildren()) do task.spawn(watchYard, y) end
end)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for sc, e in pairs(scenes) do
		for _, it in ipairs(e.items) do
			if it.spinning and it.m.Parent then
				local ax = it.m:GetAttribute("SpinAxis") == "X" and Vector3.xAxis or Vector3.yAxis
				it.m:PivotTo(it.m:GetPivot() * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ax, dt * 2.4))
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- reconnect / respawn: rebuild from the server state
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		local res = call("Sync")
		if res.ok then
			muted = res.muted == true
			muteText.Text = muted and "\u{1F515}" or "\u{1F514}"
			if res.job then startJob(res.job) elseif res.offer then offer = res.offer; dismissed[res.offer.Id] = true end
			return
		end
		task.wait(2)
	end
end)

-- PlowDriveClient (2026-10-04, Claude): driving controls + DRIVE / RECOVER buttons for the snowplow.
-- PC: WASD / arrows / gamepad stick, F = drive / exit, R = recover. Mobile: the normal thumbstick steers, the on-screen buttons do the rest.
-- The server owns spawning, seating, digging and rewards; this script only moves the plow we have network ownership of, and draws the powder spray.
-- 2026-10-05 (Claude, drive feel + drift): hold-to-drift is part of THIS controller (one Heartbeat writes the velocities): Left Shift,
-- gamepad L1 or the DRIFT button. It needs ground contact, speed and steering; lowers sideways grip, keeps momentum, bounded yaw help,
-- smooth grip return. Tuning: PlowConfig C.Drive.Drift. Wheel powder, fading skid trails, engine/skid audio and a small camera lean
-- follow the Settings toggles DriveSoundOn / ReducedMotion. Drifting never awards Snow and never exceeds the build's top speed.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("PlowConfig"))
if C.Mode ~= "Snowplow" then return end
local TX = require(RS:WaitForChild("UniversalVFX")).Textures
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("PlowRemote")
local touch = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled
local FONT, NAVY, WHITE = Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 85), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "PlowDriveGui", false, true, 51
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local function makeButton(name, label, color, pos, size)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name, b.Text, b.AnchorPoint, b.Position, b.Size = name, "", Vector2.new(1, 0.5), pos, size
	b.BackgroundColor3, b.BorderSizePixel, b.AutoButtonColor = color, 0, true
	b:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0); cr.Parent = b
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = 3; s.Color = NAVY; s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Parent = b
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Rotation = 90; g.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)); g.Parent = b
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name, l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.Text = "Label", 1, FONT, true, label
	l.TextColor3, l.Position, l.Size = WHITE, UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.12), UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.76)
	l.Parent = b
	local ls = Instance.new("UIStroke"); ls.Thickness = 2.2; ls.Color = NAVY; ls.Parent = l
	local sc = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint"); sc.MinSize = Vector2.new(touch and 130 or 118, touch and 54 or 44); sc.Parent = b
	b.Parent = gui
	return b, l
end
local drive, driveLabel = makeButton("Drive", "DRIVE", Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 105), UDim2.fromScale(0.992, 0.8), UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.17 or 0.115, touch and 0.12 or 0.066))
local recover = makeButton("Recover", touch and "RECOVER" or "RECOVER [R]", Color3.fromRGB(250, 150, 50), UDim2.fromScale(0.992, touch and 0.93 or 0.885), UDim2.fromScale(touch and 0.14 or 0.1, touch and 0.09 or 0.05))
recover.Visible = false
local msg = Instance.new("TextLabel")
msg.Name, msg.BackgroundTransparency, msg.Font, msg.TextScaled, msg.Text = "Msg", 1, FONT, true, ""
msg.AnchorPoint, msg.Position, msg.Size, msg.TextColor3, msg.TextTransparency = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.68), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.06), Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 140), 1
msg.Parent = gui
local msgStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); msgStroke.Thickness = 2.5; msgStroke.Color = NAVY; msgStroke.Transparency = 1; msgStroke.Parent = msg
local msgToken = 0
local function say(text)
	msgToken += 1
	local my = msgToken
	msg.Text, msg.TextTransparency, msgStroke.Transparency = text, 0, 0
	task.delay(2.6, function()
		if msgToken ~= my then return end
		TweenService:Create(msg, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(msgStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
	end)
end
local function refreshButtons()
	local driving = player:GetAttribute("PlowDriving") == true
	driveLabel.Text = driving and (touch and "EXIT" or "EXIT [F]") or (touch and "DRIVE" or "DRIVE [F]")
	drive.BackgroundColor3 = driving and Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 105)
	recover.Visible = driving and player:GetAttribute("InGarage") ~= true
	drive.Visible = player:GetAttribute("InGarage") ~= true and player:GetAttribute("InArenaIsland") ~= true -- no plow on the garage / arena islands
	if player:GetAttribute("InArenaIsland") ~= true then -- the arena sets its own camera distance
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = driving and 24 or 0.5 -- the camera pulls back so you can see your plow
	end
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlowDriving"):Connect(refreshButtons)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InGarage"):Connect(refreshButtons)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InArenaIsland"):Connect(refreshButtons)
refreshButtons()
local busy = false
local function ask(action)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.ok == false and res.msg then say(res.msg) end
end
drive.Activated:Connect(function() ask("Drive") end)

-- 2026-10-05 (Claude, drive fix): newer Roblox builds load the PlayerModule from StarterPlayer instead of PlayerScripts, so the old
-- WaitForChild in PlayerScripts never found it and the plow got no input. Look in both places, and fall back to reading the
-- keyboard / gamepad directly if the module is unavailable.
local controls
task.spawn(function()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while not controls and os.clock() - t0 < 30 do
		local ps = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
		local pm = (ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")) or game:GetService("StarterPlayer"):FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
		if pm and pm:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, m = pcall(require, pm)
			if ok and type(m) == "table" and m.GetControls then controls = m:GetControls() end
		end
		if not controls then task.wait(0.5) end
	end
end)
local KEYS = {[Enum.KeyCode.W] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), [Enum.KeyCode.Up] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), [Enum.KeyCode.S] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), [Enum.KeyCode.Down] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.A] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), [Enum.KeyCode.Left] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), [Enum.KeyCode.D] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), [Enum.KeyCode.Right] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)}
local function directInput()
	local v = Vector3.zero
	if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		for key, dir in pairs(KEYS) do if UIS:IsKeyDown(key) then v += dir end end
	end
	for _, st in ipairs(UIS:GetGamepadState(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1)) do
		if st.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 and st.Position.Magnitude > 0.15 then v += Vector3.new(st.Position.X, 0, -st.Position.Y) end
	end
	return v.Magnitude > 1 and v.Unit or v
end
local function moveVector()
	if RS:GetAttribute("PlowTestHooks") then
		local t = player:GetAttribute("PlowTestMove")
		if typeof(t) == "Vector3" then return t end
	end
	if controls then
		local ok, v = pcall(function() return controls:GetMoveVector() end)
		if ok and v and v.Magnitude > 0.01 then return v end
	end
	return directInput()
end

-- powder spray
local function emitter(parent, props)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Texture, e.Rate, e.LightEmission, e.LightInfluence, e.Drag = TX.smoke, 0, 0.2, 0.3, 2
	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(200, 232, 255))
	for k, v in pairs(props) do e[k] = v end
	e.Parent = parent
	return e
end
local function attachFx(model)
	local out = {}
	local blade = model:FindFirstChild("Blade")
	local bladeRoot = blade and blade:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if bladeRoot then
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.7, -2.4); a.Parent = bladeRoot
		out.blade = emitter(a, {Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9), Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 25), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0),
			Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 3.4)}),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
	end
	local b = Instance.new("Attachment"); b.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.3, 4.2); b.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	out.rear = emitter(b, {Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1), Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 20), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
		Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 2.4)}),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
	-- drift feedback (2026-10-05): compact powder at the rear wheels + short fading skid trails, made once per plow (pooled)
	local hull = model.PrimaryPart
	local gy = -(hull.Size.Y / 2 + C.Vehicle.HullClearance - 0.08) -- ground level under the hull
	out.wheels, out.trails = {}, {}
	for _, x in ipairs({-2.3, 2.3}) do
		local w = Instance.new("Attachment"); w.Name = "DriftPowder"; w.Position = Vector3.new(x, gy + 0.25, 3.1); w.Parent = hull
		table.insert(out.wheels, emitter(w, {Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.65), Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 7), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 15),
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back,
			Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.8)}),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})}))
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment"); a0.Name = "SkidA"; a0.Position = Vector3.new(x - 0.4, gy, 3.1); a0.Parent = hull
		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"); a1.Name = "SkidB"; a1.Position = Vector3.new(x + 0.4, gy, 3.1); a1.Parent = hull
		local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
		tr.Attachment0, tr.Attachment1, tr.Lifetime, tr.MinLength, tr.FaceCamera = a0, a1, 1.3, 0.2, false
		tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(150, 175, 205))
		tr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
		tr.LightInfluence, tr.Enabled = 1, false
		tr.Parent = hull
		table.insert(out.trails, tr)
	end
	local function loop(id, vol)
		local s = Instance.new("Sound"); s.SoundId, s.Looped, s.Volume = id, true, 0
		s.RollOffMaxDistance, s.RollOffMinDistance = 90, 12
		s.Parent = hull
		return s
	end
	out.engine = loop(DR.EngineSound or "rbxassetid://71482635231754")
	out.skid = loop(DR.SkidSound or "rbxassetid://103723782639124")
	return out
end

-- 2026-10-05 (Claude, car handling): raycast suspension + field detection
local fields = {}
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, SF = pcall(require, RS:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
	if ok and SF then
		local ts = SF.TileSize or 3
		for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields or {}) do
			if typeof(f.Center) == "Vector3" then table.insert(fields, {c = f.Center, hx = (f.Width or 0) * ts / 2, hz = (f.Depth or 0) * ts / 2}) end
		end
	end
end)
local function onField(p)
	for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
		if math.abs(p.X - f.c.X) <= f.hx and math.abs(p.Z - f.c.Z) <= f.hz and math.abs(p.Y - f.c.Y) < 10 then return true end
	end
	return false
end
local rideParams = RaycastParams.new()
rideParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rideParams.CollisionGroup = "PlowVehicle" -- only what the hull really collides with (players / other plows are ignored)
rideParams.RespectCanCollide = true
local CORNERS = {Vector3.new(-2.3, 0, -3.1), Vector3.new(2.3, 0, -3.1), Vector3.new(-2.3, 0, 3.1), Vector3.new(2.3, 0, 3.1)}
local function ground(hull, cf)
	rideParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {folder, player.Character}
	local reach = 1.5 + hull.Size.Y / 2 + C.Vehicle.HullClearance + C.Vehicle.RideReach
	local sumY, n, normal = 0, 0, Vector3.zero
	for _, c in ipairs(CORNERS) do
		local o = cf:PointToWorldSpace(c) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(o, Vector3.new(0, -reach, 0), rideParams)
		if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.55 then sumY += hit.Position.Y; n += 1; normal += hit.Normal end
	end
	if n == 0 then return nil end
	return sumY / n, normal.Unit
end
-- smoothing (2026-10-05): throttle and steering ease toward the input instead of snapping; yaw ramps too
local sThrottle, sSteer, sYaw = 0, 0, 0
local THROTTLE_RAMP, STEER_RAMP, YAW_RAMP = 3.5, 5, 8
local function approach(cur, target, rate, dt)
	return cur + math.clamp(target - cur, -rate * dt, rate * dt)
end

local function idle()
	if fx then
		for _, e in ipairs(fx.wheels or {}) do e.Rate = 0 end
		for _, t in ipairs(fx.trails or {}) do t.Enabled = false end
		if fx.engine then fx.engine:Stop() end
		if fx.skid then fx.skid:Stop() end
	end
	fxFor, fx = nil, nil
	sThrottle, sSteer, sYaw = 0, 0, 0
	if drifting or driftAmt > 0 then clearDrift() end
	camRestore()
	driftBtn.Visible = false
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local model = folder:FindFirstChild("Snowplow_" .. player.UserId)
	local hull = model and model.PrimaryPart
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (hull and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart.Parent == model) or player:GetAttribute("InArenaIsland") == true then
		if fxFor or driftBtn.Visible or baseFov then idle() end
		return
	end
	if fxFor ~= model then fxFor = model; fx = attachFx(model); clearDrift() end
	driftBtn.Visible = true
	dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 20)
	local mv = moveVector()
	-- 2026-10-05: the PlayerModule normalises W+D to (0.707, -0.707), which used to cut throttle to 71% in every turn. Map the circle back to
	-- a square, so full keys give full throttle AND full steering; partial stick input keeps its size.
	local m = math.max(math.abs(mv.X), math.abs(mv.Z))
	if m > 1e-3 then mv = mv * math.min(mv.Magnitude / m, 1.42) end
	-- releasing the key eases off faster than pressing it, so stops feel responsive
	local tIn, sIn = math.clamp(-mv.Z, -1, 1), math.clamp(mv.X, -1, 1)
	sThrottle = approach(sThrottle, tIn, (math.abs(tIn) < math.abs(sThrottle) or tIn * sThrottle < 0) and THROTTLE_RAMP * 2 or THROTTLE_RAMP, dt)
	sSteer = approach(sSteer, sIn, (math.abs(sIn) < math.abs(sSteer) or sIn * sSteer < 0) and STEER_RAMP * 1.6 or STEER_RAMP, dt)
	local throttle, steer = sThrottle, sSteer
	local maxSpeed, accel = hull:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed") or 20, hull:GetAttribute("Accel") or 12
	local traction, turnRate = hull:GetAttribute("Traction") or 0.6, hull:GetAttribute("TurnRate") or 2
	local pivot, stability = hull:GetAttribute("Pivot") or 0.2, hull:GetAttribute("Stability") or 1
	local cf = hull.CFrame
	-- a sudden jump (teleport, recover, respawn) ends any drift
	if lastPos and (cf.Position - lastPos).Magnitude > math.max(40, maxSpeed * 2 * dt + 20) then clearDrift() end
	lastPos = cf.Position
	local fullSpeed = maxSpeed
	if onField(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, -C.Vehicle.BladeOffset))) then maxSpeed *= C.Drive.PlowingSpeedFactor end -- heavy work: slower in the snow
	local look = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
	look = look.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
	local vel = hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local fwd, lat = vel:Dot(look), vel:Dot(right)
	local groundY, normal = ground(hull, cf)
	local grounded = groundY ~= nil

	-- drift: starts with the button held, on the ground, moving forward fast enough, while steering; ends on release, in the air or when slow
	local held = (driftKey or driftPad or driftTouch) and not typing()
	local minS = math.max(DR.MinSpeedAbs or 9, fullSpeed * (DR.MinSpeed or 0.35))
	if not drifting then
		if held and grounded and fwd > minS and math.abs(sIn) >= (DR.SteerToStart or 0.25) then drifting, driftDir = true, (sIn > 0 and 1 or -1) end
	elseif not held or not grounded or Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude < fullSpeed * (DR.ExitSpeedShare or 0.25) then
		drifting = false
	end
	driftAmt = approach(driftAmt, drifting and 1 or 0, drifting and (DR.RampIn or 6) or (DR.RampOut or 2.8), dt)

	-- engine: a little extra pull at low speed (the build's AccelTime still decides how quick it is); braking is firmer than coasting
	local target = throttle * maxSpeed * (throttle < 0 and C.Drive.ReverseFactor or 1)
	-- full-lock corners ease the target speed a little (tight turns into yards), except while drifting
	target *= 1 - (C.Drive.CornerSlow or 0) * math.abs(steer) * (1 - driftAmt)
	local braking, coasting = target * fwd < 0, math.abs(target) < math.abs(fwd) and target * fwd >= 0
	local rate
	if braking then rate = accel * C.Drive.BrakeFactor
	elseif coasting then rate = accel * (C.Drive.CoastFactor or C.Drive.BrakeFactor) * (1 - 0.6 * driftAmt) -- a drift carries its momentum
	else rate = accel * (1 + (C.Drive.LowSpeedPull or 0) * (1 - math.clamp(math.abs(fwd) / fullSpeed, 0, 1))) end
	if not grounded then rate *= C.Drive.AirControl or 0.35 end
	fwd += math.clamp(target - fwd, -rate * dt, rate * dt)
	-- sideways grip (frame-rate independent). A drift lowers it; past MaxSlip the tyres catch again so the plow can't spin out.
	local k = traction * C.Drive.LateralGrip * (1 - driftAmt * (1 - (DR.Grip or 0.14)))
	local slip = math.deg(math.atan2(math.abs(lat), math.max(math.abs(fwd), 1)))
	if slip > (DR.MaxSlip or 50) then k += (slip - (DR.MaxSlip or 50)) * (DR.SlipCatch or 0.6) end
	if not grounded then k *= 0.25 end
	local lat0 = lat
	lat *= math.exp(-k * dt)
	if not drifting and driftAmt > 0 then -- leaving a drift: part of the sideways speed swings back to forward, never above top speed
		fwd = math.clamp(fwd + (math.abs(lat0) - math.abs(lat)) * (DR.ExitCarry or 0.35), -maxSpeed, math.max(maxSpeed, fwd))
	end
	if driftAmt > 0 then
		local drag = math.exp(-(DR.Drag or 0.12) * driftAmt * dt)
		fwd, lat = fwd * drag, lat * drag
	end
	local planar = look * fwd + right * lat
	if driftAmt > 0 and planar.Magnitude > fullSpeed then planar = planar.Unit * fullSpeed end -- a slide never goes faster than the build's top speed
	-- suspension: hold the collision box HullClearance above the ground under the four corners, so small steps, path slabs and
	-- kerbs lift the plow instead of stopping it (anything taller than the clearance - walls, gates, barriers - still blocks it)
	local vy = vel.Y
	if grounded then
		local want = groundY + C.Vehicle.HullClearance + hull.Size.Y / 2
		vy = math.clamp((want - cf.Position.Y) * C.Vehicle.RideStiffness, -C.Vehicle.RideMaxFall, C.Vehicle.RideMaxRise)
	end
	hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(planar.X, vy, planar.Z)
	-- car steering: needs speed (Pivot gears still turn on the spot), full at TurnSpeedFull x top speed, a bit wider when going fast
	local speedFactor = math.clamp(math.abs(fwd) / (fullSpeed * C.Drive.TurnSpeedFull), math.max(C.Drive.MinTurn, pivot), 1)
	speedFactor *= 1 - C.Drive.HighSpeedTurnLoss * math.clamp((math.abs(fwd) / fullSpeed - 0.6) / 0.4, 0, 1)
	local yaw = -steer * turnRate * speedFactor * (fwd < -0.5 and -1 or 1)
	if driftAmt > 0 then -- bounded yaw help: turns in tighter while drifting; countersteering (steer against the slide) eases it out
		yaw *= 1 + (DR.YawBoost or 0.55) * driftAmt
		local cap = turnRate * (1 + (DR.YawBoost or 0.55))
		yaw = math.clamp(yaw, -cap, cap)
	end
	if not grounded then yaw *= 0.4 end
	sYaw = approach(sYaw, yaw, YAW_RAMP * math.max(1, turnRate) * (drifting and 1.3 or 1), dt)
	-- the body follows the ground (pitch / roll on slopes and steps) instead of always staying level; harder when badly tilted (bump recovery)
	local up = normal or Vector3.yAxis
	local tilt = cf.UpVector:Dot(up)
	local assist = C.Drive.UprightAssist * stability * (tilt < 0.9 and (C.Drive.TiltRecover or 1.6) or 1)
	hull.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, sYaw, 0) + cf.UpVector:Cross(up) * assist

	-- feedback: powder / trails / sound only on the ground and when moving
	local speed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
	local moving = grounded and speed > 2
	if fx then
		if fx.blade then fx.blade.Rate = moving and math.clamp(speed * 2.2, 0, 42) or 0 end
		if fx.rear then fx.rear.Rate = moving and math.clamp(speed * 1.1, 0, 22) or 0 end
		local sliding = moving and driftAmt > 0.25
		local reduced = reducedMotion()
		for _, e in ipairs(fx.wheels or {}) do e.Rate = sliding and math.clamp(speed * 1.4 * driftAmt, 0, reduced and 10 or 26) or 0 end
		for _, t in ipairs(fx.trails or {}) do t.Enabled = sliding end
		local soundOn = driveSoundOn()
		if fx.engine then
			if soundOn then
				if not fx.engine.IsPlaying then fx.engine:Play() end
				fx.engine.Volume = 0.1 + 0.12 * math.abs(throttle)
				fx.engine.PlaybackSpeed = 0.85 + 0.45 * math.clamp(speed / fullSpeed, 0, 1)
			elseif fx.engine.IsPlaying then fx.engine:Stop() end
		end
		if fx.skid then
			local want = (soundOn and sliding) and 0.32 * driftAmt * math.clamp(slip / 25, 0.3, 1) or 0
			if want > 0.01 then
				if not fx.skid.IsPlaying then fx.skid:Play() end
				fx.skid.Volume = want
			elseif fx.skid.IsPlaying then fx.skid:Stop() end
		end
		-- camera: +up to 4 FOV and ~2 degrees of lean while drifting (off with reduced motion)
		cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			if not baseFov then baseFov = cam.FieldOfView end
			local wantFov = reduced and baseFov or baseFov + (DR.CameraFov or 4) * driftAmt * math.clamp(speed / fullSpeed, 0, 1)
			cam.FieldOfView += (wantFov - cam.FieldOfView) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
			camLean = reduced and 0 or -driftDir * math.rad(DR.CameraLean or 2) * driftAmt
		end
	end
	hull:SetAttribute("Drift", driftAmt > 0.05 and math.floor(driftAmt * 100 + 0.5) / 100 or nil) -- read by tests / other clients' effects
end)

-- PassClient (2026-10-05, Claude, task 8): three compact snowy offer cards on the RIGHT side of the HUD (PassConfig).

-- when sales are on and the pass is really for sale). Prices come from MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync (regional pricing);
-- no fake timers or discounts. States: loading / owned / coming soon (no id, sales off or not for sale) / price.
-- Hidden on the arena island, during the intro / first tutorial, during events (SuppressEvents) and while a menu panel is open.

	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end

-- left of the REWARDS / SPIN icons, below the top-right event banner and above DRIVE / EXIT (measured on the live HUD 2026-10-05)
local column = mk("Frame", {Name = "Offers", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.9, -6, 0.38, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.135, 0, 0.245, 0)}, gui)

label(toggle, "\u{2B50} OFFERS", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.72), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.14)})

-- details popup
local pop = mk("Frame", {Name = "OfferDetails", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 102, 190), Visible = false}, gui)
pop:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.06, 0)}, pop); stroke(pop, 4)

mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 225), Color3.fromRGB(32, 64, 135))}, pop)

mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0.02, 0), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, popList)

local owned, info, cards = {}, {}, {}
local current
local function priceText(pass)
	if owned[pass.Key] then return "OWNED \u{2713}" end
	local i = info[pass.Key]
	if not P.SalesEnabled or not pass.Id or (i and i.ForSale == false) then return "COMING SOON" end
	if i == nil then return "..." end
	if i.Failed then return "UNAVAILABLE" end
	return "\u{E002} " .. tostring(i.Price) -- Robux glyph + the real player-facing price
end
local function canBuy(pass)
	local i = info[pass.Key]
	return P.SalesEnabled and pass.Id ~= nil and not owned[pass.Key] and i ~= nil and i.ForSale == true and not i.Failed
end
local function refresh()
	for key, c in pairs(cards) do
		c.price.Text = priceText(c.pass)
		c.frame.BackgroundColor3 = owned[key] and Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 80) or c.pass.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(30, 60, 120), 0.45)
	end

		popPrice.Text = priceText(current)
		local ok = canBuy(current)
		popBuy.AutoButtonColor = ok
		popBuy.BackgroundColor3 = ok and Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 105) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 158, 175)
		popBuyText.Text = owned[current.Key] and "OWNED" or (ok and "BUY" or "COMING SOON")
	end
end
local function openDetails(pass)
	current = pass
	popIcon.Image = pass.Icon or ""
	popTitle.Text = pass.Name
	for _, c in ipairs(popList:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextLabel") then c:Destroy() end end
	for i, line in ipairs(pass.Details or {}) do
		label(popList, "\u{2022} " .. line, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.15), LayoutOrder = i, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 240, 255)})

	pop.Visible = true
	refresh()
end
popBuy.Activated:Connect(function()
	if current and canBuy(current) then MPS:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, current.Id) end -- explicit click only; the server verifies + grants
end)

for i, pass in ipairs(P.Passes) do
	local f = mk("TextButton", {Name = pass.Key, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.31), LayoutOrder = i, BackgroundColor3 = pass.Color, Selectable = true}, column)
	f:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.22, 0)}, f); stroke(f, 3)
	mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(190, 205, 230))}, f)
	local icon = mk("ImageLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = pass.Icon or "", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.06), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.88), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit}, f)
	label(f, pass.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.33, 0.06), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.64, 0.34), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left})

	local price = label(f, "...", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.33, 0.66), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.64, 0.28), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 140)})
	cards[pass.Key] = {frame = f, price = price, pass = pass, icon = icon}
	f.Activated:Connect(function() openDetails(pass) end)
end

-- real prices (regional) + ownership; never prompts automatically
task.spawn(function()
	for _, pass in ipairs(P.Passes) do
		if pass.Id and P.SalesEnabled then
			local ok, res
			for attempt = 1, 3 do

-- Snowy art skin. Visuals only; the existing scripts still own state and actions.
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local M = {}
M.Assets = {
	panel = "rbxassetid://73131475669125", card = "rbxassetid://108488334852650", button = "rbxassetid://100281398843170", hex = "rbxassetid://92134257087385",
	damage = "rbxassetid://78096846367053", rewards = "rbxassetid://77298391197868", achievement = "rbxassetid://89448212190860", loading = "rbxassetid://114230466916343",
	snow = "rbxassetid://83244601927288", luck = "rbxassetid://74613534440214",
	quests = "rbxassetid://104333252369153", codes = "rbxassetid://116424506095790",
}
-- Roblox's uploaded texture is 1024px; source PNGs are preserved at 1254px.
M.Slice = Rect.new(237, 237, 787, 787)
local loaded, waiting = {}, {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function whenReady(id, fn)
	if not RunService:IsRunning() or loaded[id] == true or ContentProvider:GetAssetFetchStatus(id)==Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then fn() return end
	if loaded[id] == false then return end
	waiting[id] = waiting[id] or {}
	table.insert(waiting[id], fn)
end
if RunService:IsClient() then
	for _, id in pairs(M.Assets) do
		if not waiting[id] then
			waiting[id] = {}
			task.spawn(function()
				local success = false
				local ok = pcall(function()
					ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({id}, function(_, status) success = status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success end)
				end)
				loaded[id] = ok and success
				if loaded[id] then for _, fn in ipairs(waiting[id]) do fn() end end
				waiting[id] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- 2026-10-03 (Claude): frosty window/card art is slightly see-through (button art stays solid).
M.SkinTransparency = 0.12

-- Art is below content. Layout containers are deliberately excluded.
function M.Skin(o, kind)
	if not o:IsA("GuiObject") or bound[o] then return end
	if o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout") then return end
	bound[o] = true
	if kind ~= "panel" then
		-- 2026-10-04 (Claude, user: "all of the that are round have that stupid borders"): buttons, banners, badges, pills and cards no
		-- longer get the pale frosty rim (it doubled their own outline and swallowed small widgets). They keep their own colour and get
		-- one clean navy outline if they have none. Window frames keep their art (their Background images are not drawn by this function).
		local isText = o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") or o:IsA("TextLabel")
		local hasBorder = false
		for _, c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("UIStroke") and (not isText or c.ApplyStrokeMode == Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border) then hasBorder = true break end
		end
		if not hasBorder then
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			s.Name = "SnowOutline"
			s.Thickness = kind == "button" and 3 or 2.5
			s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 85)
			s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
			s.Parent = o
		end
		return
	end
	local art = o:FindFirstChild("SnowArt") or Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	art.Name = "SnowArt"
	art:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	art.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	art.Active, art.Selectable = false, false
	art.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	art.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	art.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	art.ZIndex = math.max(0, o.ZIndex - 1)
	art.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	art.SliceCenter = M.Slice
	art.SliceScale = kind == "panel" and 0.2 or 0.055
	art.Visible = true -- transparent unloaded art leaves the native card readable
	art.ImageTransparency = kind == "button" and 0 or M.SkinTransparency
	local function selectImage()
		local id = kind == "panel" and M.Assets.panel or M.Assets.card
		if kind == "button" then
			local c = o.BackgroundColor3
			local semantic = o.Text~="" or c.R > c.B * 1.2 or c.G > c.B * 1.15 or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
			id = semantic and M.Assets.card or M.Assets.button
		end
		art.Image, art.Visible = id, true
		art.ImageRectOffset, art.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero, Vector2.zero
		art.SliceCenter = M.Slice
		if id == M.Assets.button then
			-- Keep native alpha; sample the tight button rectangle without resampling the PNG.
			art.ImageRectOffset, art.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 343), Vector2.new(1024, 343)
			art.SliceCenter, art.SliceScale = Rect.new(204, 102, 820, 241), 0.07
		end
		whenReady(id, function() if art.Parent and art.Image == id then art.Visible = true end end)
	end
	art.Parent = o
	selectImage()
	if kind == "button" then o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(selectImage) end
	return art
end

function M.Icon(parent, id, pos, size, name)
	local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	img.Name = name or "SnowSymbol"
	img:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	img.Active, img.Selectable = false, false
	img.Image, img.ScaleType = id, Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	img.Position, img.Size = pos, size
	img.ZIndex = parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.ZIndex + 1 or 1
	img.Parent = parent
	return img
end

function M.Hex(holder, rects)
	local img=M.Icon(holder,M.Assets.hex,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),"SnowHex")
	img.ZIndex=holder.ZIndex img.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	img.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(124,50) img.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(1006,1154)
	img.Visible=false
	local function sync()
		img.ImageColor3=rects[1].BackgroundColor3:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.12)
		img.ImageTransparency=rects[1].BackgroundTransparency
	end
	sync()
	rects[1]:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(sync)
	rects[1]:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency"):Connect(sync)
	whenReady(M.Assets.hex,function()
		if holder.Parent then
			img.Visible=true for _,r in ipairs(rects) do r.Visible=false end
		end
	end)
	return img
end

local accepted = {RNGGui=true, Tutorial=true, SnowArrivalGui=true, DiceBannerGui=true, TreasureToastGui=true, World2Toast=true, StageToast=true, FrostfallToast=true}
local seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function rootOf(o)
	local root = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
	if root and accepted[root.Name] then return root end
	local bb = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
	if bb and (bb.Name:sub(1,8)=="PetSign_" or bb.Name=="SnowPrompt") then return bb end
	local surface = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
	local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
	if surface and not (zones and surface:IsDescendantOf(zones)) then return surface end
end
local function apply(o)
	if not o or not o.Parent or o:GetAttribute("SnowUIDecor") or seen[o] or not o:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
	local root = rootOf(o)
	if not root then return end
	if o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		o.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124,224,255)
		o.ScrollBarThickness = math.min(o.ScrollBarThickness,7)
		seen[o] = true return
	end
	if o:IsA("ImageLabel") and o.Name=="Background" and o.Parent.Parent and o.Parent.Parent.Name=="Panels" then
		seen[o] = true
		whenReady(M.Assets.panel,function()
			if o.Parent then o.Image=M.Assets.panel o.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Slice o.SliceCenter=M.Slice o.SliceScale=0.2 end
		end)
		return
	end
	if o.Name=="Shadow" or o.Name=="Glow" or o.Name=="Aura" or o.Name=="Fill" or o.Name=="Shine" then return end
	if root:IsA("SurfaceGui") and o.Parent==root and o.BackgroundTransparency<0.9 then
		if not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
			local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0.1,0) c.Parent=o
		end
		seen[o]=true M.Skin(o,"card") return
	end
	if o:IsA("Frame") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
		if o.BackgroundTransparency>=0.9 or not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then return end
		-- A sibling border follows the automatic-size box without influencing its measurement.
		if o.AutomaticSize~=Enum.AutomaticSize.None then
			if root.Name=="Tutorial" then
				o.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,73,122)
				seen[o]=true
				-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): one clean icy outline instead of the frosty sibling border image
				if not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") then
					local s=Instance.new("UIStroke") s.Thickness=3 s.Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,215,255) s.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border s.Parent=o
				end
			end
			return
		end
		local content=o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")
		for _,c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("ViewportFrame") or c:IsA("ImageLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton") then content=true break end
		end
		if not content then return end
		seen[o]=true
		M.Skin(o,o:IsA("TextButton") and "button" or "card")
	end
end
function M.Attach(container)
	for _,o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do apply(o) end
	return container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
		task.defer(function()
			if o:IsA("UICorner") or o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("ViewportFrame") then apply(o.Parent) end
			apply(o)
		end)
	end)
end
function M.StyleTree(container)
	for _,o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do apply(o) end
end
function M.SnowBackground(parent)
	local img=M.Icon(parent,M.Assets.loading,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),"SnowBackdrop")
	img.ZIndex=0 img.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	img.ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,140,185) img.ImageTransparency=0.52
	return img
end
return M

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60)
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80)
local N = #W.Segments

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
-- everything in this panel skips SnowUI's automatic frost overlay (same clean style as the other menus)
local function frame(parent, props)
	local f = mk("Frame", {BorderSizePixel = 0}, nil)
	f:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do f[k] = v end
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end
local function round(o, r) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 0.5, 0)}, o) return o end
local function outline(o, t, c) return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = t, Color = c or NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o) end
local function grad(o, a, b) return mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(a, b)}, o) end
local function text(parent, str, props, max, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = str, TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2, Color = NAVY}, l) end
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = max or 30}, l)
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end
local function button(parent, props)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true, BorderSizePixel = 0}, nil)
	b:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	b.Parent = parent
	return b
end

-- A wheel face. GUI has no wedge shape, so every slice is filled with thin spokes: an invisible full-diameter arm turned around
-- the centre with its top half coloured (Roblox turns frames around their middle, which sits on the wheel's centre).
local function face(parent, step, labelled, z0)
	local rotor = frame(parent, {Name = "Rotor", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = z0})
	local function arm(angle, width, color, name, z)
		local a = frame(rotor, {Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(width, 1), Rotation = angle, ZIndex = z})
		if color then frame(a, {BackgroundColor3 = color, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), ZIndex = z}) end
		return a
	end
	local width = math.sin(math.rad(step) / 2) * 1.3 -- a little wider than the gap between spokes at the rim
	for i, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do
		local a0 = (i - 1) * SEG
		local a = a0 + step / 2
		while a < a0 + SEG do arm(a, width, s.Color, "Spoke", z0); a += step end
	end
	for i = 0, N - 1 do arm(i * SEG, 0.014, WHITE, "Divider", z0 + 1) end
	local labels = {}
	if labelled then
		for i, s in ipairs(W.Segments) do
			local slot = arm((i - 0.5) * SEG, 0.3, nil, "Slice" .. i, z0 + 2)
			local icon = mk("ImageLabel", {Name = "Icon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = SnowUI.Assets[s.Icon] or SnowUI.Assets.snow, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.11), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.12), ZIndex = z0 + 2}, nil)
			icon:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
			icon.Parent = slot
			local main = text(slot, "", {Name = "Main", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.21), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.075), ZIndex = z0 + 2}, 26)
			local sub = text(slot, "", {Name = "Sub", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.27), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.045), ZIndex = z0 + 2}, 16, 1.5)
			labels[i] = {main = main, sub = sub}
		end
	end
	return rotor, labels
end

local function setSpins(n)
	spins = math.max(0, tonumber(n) or 0)
	count.Text = tostring(spins)
	badge.Visible = spins > 0
	badgeLabel.Text = spins > 9 and "9+" or tostring(spins)
	local can = spins > 0 and not spinning
	spinGrad.Color = can and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 140), Color3.fromRGB(40, 175, 80))
		or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 198, 214), Color3.fromRGB(140, 150, 172))

	hint.Text = spins > 0 and ("You have " .. spins .. (spins == 1 and " free spin!" or " free spins!"))

	if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
	for i, l in ipairs(labels) do
		local p = list[i]
		if p then l.main.Text = p.Text or ""; l.sub.Text = p.Sub or "" end

local CONFETTI = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60), Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 130), Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 170), Color3.fromRGB(190, 120, 255)}
local function confetti()
	for i = 1, 16 do
		local ang = math.rad(i * 22.5 + math.random(-8, 8))
		local piece = frame(holder, {BackgroundColor3 = CONFETTI[i % #CONFETTI + 1], AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.035, 0.05), Rotation = math.random(0, 90), ZIndex = 12})
		round(piece, 0.3)
		local dist = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.2
		TweenService:Create(piece, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.sin(ang) * dist, 0.5 - math.cos(ang) * dist),
			Rotation = piece.Rotation + 200, BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.85, function() piece:Destroy() end)
	end
end

local function showResult(p)
	if type(p) ~= "table" then return end
	result.Visible = true
	resultIcon.Image = ICON[p.Kind] or SnowUI.Assets.rewards
	resultText.Text = (p.Kind == "Jackpot" and "JACKPOT! " or "YOU WON ") .. (p.Long or p.Text or "")
	resultScale.Scale = 0.6
	TweenService:Create(resultScale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end

local function spin()
	if spinning then return end
	if spins <= 0 then
		hint.Text = "Unlock a new stage to get a free spin!"
		return
	end
	spinning = true
	setSpins(spins)
	result.Visible = false
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("Spin") end)
	if not (ok and type(res) == "table" and res.Ok and res.Index) then
		spinning = false
		setSpins(type(res) == "table" and res.Spins or spins)
		if type(res) == "table" and res.Msg then hint.Text = res.Msg end
		return
	end
	-- land the chosen slice under the pointer: slice i's middle sits at (i - 0.5) * SEG degrees on the rotor
	local mid = (res.Index - 0.5) * SEG
	local jitter = (math.random() - 0.5) * SEG * 0.6
	local target = rotation - (rotation % 360) - mid + jitter
	while target < rotation + 360 * 5 do target += 360 end
	local tw = TweenService:Create(rotor, TweenInfo.new(W.SpinSeconds or 4.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Rotation = target})
	tw:Play()
	tw.Completed:Wait()
	rotation = target
	spinning = false
	showPrizes(res.Prizes)
	setSpins(player:GetAttribute("WheelSpins") or res.Spins)
	showResult(res.Prize)
	confetti()
end

		showToast(n - known == 1 and "NEW STAGE! You earned a FREE SPIN!" or ("You earned " .. (n - known) .. " FREE SPINS!"))
	end
	known = n
end)
